function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends a GET request to the specified URL and retrieves data as specified by the parameters. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL to which the GET request is sent. It is expected to be a well-formed HTTP or HTTPS URL.

Content-Type.description: The MIME type of the body of the request (used with POST and PUT requests).

Accept.description: The Media type(s) that is/are acceptable for the response.

headers.description: A dictionary of HTTP headers to send with the request. Each key-value pair represents a header name and its value.

timeout.description: The number of seconds to wait for the server to send data before giving up, as a float, or a (connect_timeout, read_timeout) tuple. This is a float type value.

lat.description: Latitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

lon.description: Longitude of the location for the query, in degrees. This is a float type value.

params.description: Query parameters to append to the URL for the GET request.

allow_redirects.description: Determines if HTTP redirections (301, 302, etc.) should be followed.

auth.description: A tuple representing the user credentials for HTTP authentication, typically in the form of (username, password).

cert.description: Path to an SSL certificate file to verify the peer, or a tuple of (certificate file, key file).

cookies.description: A dictionary of cookies to send with the request. The key is the cookie name and the value is the cookie value.

http.description: URL of the proxy for HTTP requests.

https.description: URL of the proxy for HTTPS requests.

proxies.description: A dictionary mapping protocol names to the URL of the proxy.

stream.description: If True, the response content will not be downloaded immediately but streamed.

verify.description: Whether to verify the server's TLS certificate or not, or a path to a CA bundle if verification is needed.

Here are a few ways you can get a cake delivered (or pick one up) depending on what’s most convenient for you: | Option | What it offers | How to order | Tips | |--------|----------------|--------------|------| | **Local bakeries** | Fresh, often custom‑made cakes. Many offer online ordering or phone reservations. | • Search “cake shop near me” on Google Maps or Yelp.
• Call the bakery directly or use their website if they have one. | • Ask about delivery times and any special packaging.
• If you’re ordering a custom design, book at least a week in advance. | | **Online cake delivery services** | Nationwide or regional delivery, often with a wide variety of flavors and designs. | • **Goldbelly** – delivers from famous bakeries across the U.S.
• **Etsy** – many independent bakers ship nationwide.
• **Amazon Fresh** – offers cakes from local vendors in some cities. | • Check shipping dates; some cakes need to be shipped in a cooler.
• Read reviews to ensure quality. | | **Grocery stores & supermarkets** | Ready‑made cakes, often with a “pick‑up” or “delivery” option. | • **Whole Foods**, **Trader Joe’s**, **Kroger**, **Safeway**, etc.
• Use their online shopping portal or app. | • Look for “Bakery” or “Desserts” sections.
• Some stores offer same‑day delivery via Instacart or their own service. | | **Specialty dessert shops** | Gourmet or themed cakes (e.g., vegan, gluten‑free, keto). | • Search for “vegan cake delivery” or “gluten‑free cake shop” in your area.
• Many have dedicated websites or Instagram pages. | • Verify dietary claims by asking for ingredient lists. | | **Catering companies** | Great for events; they can handle large orders and custom designs. | • Call local caterers or use platforms like **Thumbtack** or **Zola** to find one. | • Ask about delivery fees and minimum order requirements. | ### Quick steps to place an order 1. **Decide on the type of cake** (birthday, wedding, custom design, dietary restrictions). 2. **Choose a provider** from the table above that fits your budget and delivery needs. 3. **Place the order**: * If ordering online, fill out the form, choose delivery date/time, and pay. * If calling, give them the cake details, delivery address, and any special instructions. 4. **Confirm**: Make sure you receive an order confirmation (email or text) and a delivery estimate. --- #### Need help finding a specific place?
